$comment: The slot manifest. Every fact that makes this harness THIS site's harness
lives here, so cutting the template means replacing this file plus
scripts/rules.site/ and jobs/missions/ -- and nothing else.
Step 2 of the extraction plan in docs/harness-audit-2026-08.md.
Loaded synchronously at import time by scripts/core/config.mjs. That
matters: rules build their label strings when their module is evaluated,
so config must be populated before any rule module body runs. ESM
evaluates imports depth-first, so a synchronous read in config.mjs is
guaranteed to win that race. See config.mjs for the full explanation.

caps.$comment: Issues or PRs one run may produce. Scouts differ by remit.

validator.$comment_ignorePaths: Paths the host injects at runtime, correctly absent from the repo.
validator.$comment_skipDirs: Directories that are not site content. Dot-directories are always skipped, whatever this says.

pageShape.$comment: The markup shapes this site's generated pages share.

$comment_specFields: WHICH spec fields are cross-checked against body prose. HOW each one is
tokenised cannot live in JSON -- '2.5G' and '2.5 Gigabit Ethernet'
collapsing to the same token is code, and it stays in
scripts/rules.site/spec-contradiction.mjs. This is a partial slot: the
list is configurable, the tokenisers are a module a new site replaces.
